table inet firewall {
	set quic {
		type inet_service
		elements = { 443 }
	}
	chain input {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		ct state vmap { invalid : drop, established : accept, related : accept }
		iifname "lo" accept
		ip saddr 203.0.113.0/24 tcp dport 8443 accept
		tcp dport vmap { 22 : accept, 80 : accept, 443 : accept }
		udp dport @quic accept
		counter comment "count dropped"
	}
}
